I'm actually fine if you remove gxp.dts, but if you're going to remove the dts you should remove the bbappend as well. If you're doing that, the whole meta-dl360poc layer should probably be removed too.

> I'm actually fine if you remove gxp.dts, but if you're going to remove the dts you should remove the bbappend as well. If you're doing that, the whole meta-dl360poc layer should probably be removed too.

Is there still an effort to get the DTS upstream?  What is the timeline for it?

As far as I am aware internally, no, there are no further efforts to upstream Gen11 (GXP) platforms, though I did stumble upon https://canopybmc.org/ yesterday. I have no insider knowledge about anything happening with 9elements though, I can only speak for Gen12 (GSC) and newer platforms.

@ian.woloschin@hpe.com My goal was to start a conversation here.  What do you want to see happen to gxp.dts?  Agreed, mechanically we could remove the whole meta layer.  Is that something you want to push?  is gxp.dts something you care about anymore or provides any usefulness to you?
Good question! As far as I am aware, there was no ongoing support for Gen11 systems, but it seems @christian.walter@9elements.com may be working on this?

@christian.walter@9elements.com - One of the proposed patches to be removed is, I think, related to the platforms canopybmc is now working on with HPE.  Do you want to weigh in here?  Are you planning on upstreaming better support for the dl360 platform?

Hi,
yes - we are actively developing on all Gen11 machines including the DL360 and will definitely upstream better support for all Gen11 - including dl360.

@christian.walter@9elements.com What do you want to see happen in the context of this patch? If you can give me an approximate timeframe for when you'll push the DTS to lkml, I'm happy to avoid breaking the DL360 for now, or if you'd rather we start fresh, and just let your new patch speak for itself, that's fine too.
We will start fresh - it's fine for us if we drop it here.
